text:
julia (docs): Hey team — I'm opening a PR to update the model catalog + individual model cards for the new quantized variants and accuracy/throughput rows. Need quick facts and a sanity check before I merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823

sam (ml): Thanks Julia. Quick data points I can confirm now: Mistral-7B-v0 (float32) — 32k context, ~5.8 tokens/ms on our p4d-8x; Mistral-7B-q4_0 — 32k context, ~9.3 tokens/ms. Llama3-8B (v1) — 16k context official, we support 32k truncated up to 32k but with degraded perf after 20k.

nate (eng): @julia note on compatibility: the q4_0 quantized artifacts are ABI-compatible with our runtime, but customers using Dedicated older than 2024-09 might need the new runtime tag (rwinf-2024.10) — add note in migration section. Also, we should surface the maximum key-value cache size limit: 48GB per model shard on Dedicated nodes.

maya (product): From a product POV we need a clear "recommended for" line on each card (e.g., low-latency inference, batch scoring, embeddings). Also call out which variants are eligible for Redwood Optimize auto-quantize suggestions.

julia (docs): Good catches. I'll add a migration snippet. Can you paste the exact runtime upgrade command? I'll include it in the migration guide.

nate (eng): Sure — for Dedicated customers:

```
# on control-plane node
rwctl agents upgrade --image=redwood/runtime:rwinf-2024.10 --force
```

Add a quick note: rolling upgrade will preserve running sessions but KV cache flush is required for model shard upgrades.

sam (ml): Also adding benchmark links + small sample scripts: for python SDK generation (streaming) use:

```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
# model: mistral-7b-q4_0
resp = client.generate(model="mistral-7b-q4_0", input="Summarize: Why inference costs vary by batch size", max_tokens=128, stream=False)
print(resp.text)
```

and curl example:

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"mistral-7b-q4_0","input":"Hello world","max_tokens":16}'
```

julia (docs): Perfect. I'll add both snippets and a short note about model name normalization (we list canonical names in the catalog: "mistral-7b-q4_0" vs internal artifact tags). Also will include a short compatibility table for Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private.

maya (product): Heads-up: marketing asked to keep benchmark numbers rounded and include hardware callouts (e.g., p4d-8x vs a100-80gb) — don't put raw perf numbers on the high-level card, keep detailed table in the expandable section.

julia (docs): Got it. I'll keep a summary on the card and deep-dive table below. @sam can you upload the CSV of raw runs to the PR (or link to the benchmark bucket) so I can reference it?

sam (ml): Uploaded to the benchmark bucket: s3://redwood-bench/mistral7b/q4_0/runs/2025-02-12.csv — added link in my PR comment.

docs-bot: [auto] checklist: model card metadata present, sdk snippets present, migration notes present, links validated. Missing: example tests.

julia (docs): I'll add a simple example test under examples/ that runs the python snippet with a short smoke check. Also fixing an old markdown link on the Mistral card that pointed to the vendor page (broken).

nate (eng): One more technical detail: when listing token limits, please separate "supported context window" (what model was trained with) vs "supported by runtime" (what we accept + behavior). E.g., Llama3-8B: trained 16k, runtime accepts 32k with truncation beyond 20k.

julia (docs): Good call. I'll add those two columns. Anything else?

maya (product): Quick editorial: add a "Known issues" bullet if a variant may produce higher latency variance (e.g., q5_1 on small GPUs).

sam (ml): FYI — q5_1 still experimental for some sequences; we should mark it as "lab-tested" on the card.

julia (docs): Cool. I'll push an update to PR #4823 in ~30m with your edits and ping for approvals. Please leave any final nit comments on the PR (tag me @julia). :sparkles:

nate (eng): LGTM, will add a short note on shard memory usage in the compatibility table.

maya (product): Reviewing after your push. Thanks all! :heart:
